title: Outstandingly Oven Roasted British Cheese Ploughmans Bake
description: A crowd-pleasing British dish featuring lemon and cheese, this ploughmans bake is a sour and silky delight, perfect for a gathering of friends and family. It is a raw-friendly and easy to make dish.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 degrees Celsius.
In a large bowl, mix together the Wensleydale and Lancashire cheese.
Add the sliced apples, pickles, and lemon juice to the bowl and stir well.
Butter the crusty bread and place it in the oven for 5 minutes to toast.
Remove the bread from the oven and top it with the cheese mixture.
Return the bread to the oven and bake for 10 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove the bake from the oven and sprinkle with chopped fresh parsley.
Serve the ploughmans bake hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
